fact: In October 2026 the Ministry of Economy and Finance engaged a consortium (GDI Advisors, DMS Logistics, Orbus Digital Services Gaïnde 2000) on a one-year, 80.8 million CFA franc mission to support development of a predictive customs revenue forecasting model, which the article calls an algorithmic model; it is not described as in service.
title: Recettes douanières : le Bénin veut affiner ses prévisions avec l'appui de trois cabinets
